title: Book Three · Chapter 16: The Cool Morning
story:
Two weeks later, the mornings are cooler.

Ronan wears a thin coat on the way to school. By lunch, he carries it over one arm.

Anna stands near the classroom door with her friend. Both have their water bottles.

“The track?” Ronan asks.

Anna nods. “Come with us.”

He puts his coat in his bag. Downstairs, a yellow leaf moves across the path in front of them.

The field is bright. The air feels different from the hot first week. Ronan walks to the bench and leaves his bottle there.

Anna's friend starts first. Anna follows her. Ronan takes the outside line and runs at his own speed.

At the first turn, the wind blows into his face. He closes his mouth for a moment. Then he looks ahead again.

The girls are already farther round the track.

Near the end of his lap, Anna comes past him. She is on her second lap now.

“Nearly there,” she says.

“I know where the bench is.”

She laughs and keeps going.

Ronan reaches the bench. He walks a little, then picks up his bottle.

Kai and his friend cross the grass with a ball. Kai waves him over.

Ronan holds up the bottle. He needs another drink first.

When Anna finishes, she sits down for a moment. Her friend stays on her feet.

“We started too fast,” Anna says.

“You did,” her friend answers. “I tried to follow.”

Anna nods. “Next time, start without me.”

She takes a long drink. Ronan looks toward the boys on the grass.

“I'm going over there.”

“All right. See you upstairs.”

Kai throws him the ball gently. Ronan catches it with one hand against his chest.

“Only one hand today?” Kai asks.

Ronan puts down his bottle.

“The other one was busy.”

They pass the ball between the three of them. Kai's friend tries a quick turn and misses. The ball rolls toward the track.

Ronan follows it. Anna stops it with her shoe and sends it back across the grass.

“Thank you!” he calls.

The bell rings soon after that. Everyone moves toward the building.

Upstairs, Ronan gets his coat from the bag. He does not put it on yet. Anna opens the window a little.

Cool air reaches the desk. A corner of her loose paper lifts, and she puts her ruler across it.

Ronan puts a hand over his own page.

“The wind wants maths too,” he says.

Anna moves the ruler between the two sheets.

“It can share this one.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cooler＝更凉快的；thin coat＝薄外套；outside line＝外侧的线；keep going＝继续前进。

## 理解问题

1. 本章距第四周的修理场景过去多久？天气有什么变化？
2. Anna怎样发现自己和朋友的起跑速度不合适？Ronan跑完后做了什么？

## 读句子

**He puts his coat in his bag.**

拆开看：He / puts his coat / in his bag.

他／把外套放好／放进书包里。
